dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop and semi-closed light-toned perimeters with sharp exterior contrast transitions. The 3-5 most prominent structures show a distinct light-to-dark gradient from the ring edge toward the center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixels without internal gradients distributed across the posterior-lateral region. High spatial density of small, irregular light-toned spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. Centroids of the high-intensity blobs on the posterior flank form a sub-linear descending sequence.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Five parallel, diagonal linear indentations visible on the anterior-dorsal region. A high-saturation red linear mark is located in the interdigital webbing of the visible posterior flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: The animal displays a comprehensive reticulated coat pattern. The high-saturation red mark is an atypical high-contrast feature.
